ask_user.prompt: Is the target board currently connected?
ask_user.condition: HARDWARE is not generic. When not applicable, silently set to N/A — informing user not required.

ask_user.prompt: Any constraints you'd like to mention before I start?

query_model.derive: true when HARDWARE is a real MCU/board

ask_user.prompt: What metric do you want to optimize?
Do you need runtime measurements (SIL/PIL) or static code analysis only (codegen)?
ask_user.constraint: codegen is NOT valid when GOAL is speed or balance — execution-time optimization requires running code. Auto-select SIL (generic/desktop hardware) or PIL (real board connected).

ask_user.prompt: Are you willing to trade any resource? Any hard constraints (e.g., max RAM, deadline)?

query_model.derive: time when GOAL is speed/balance, stack when GOAL is RAM

routes.description: Optimizes Simulink models for Embedded Coder generated code. Use when asked to optimize or improve generated code, or reduce code metrics for a Simulink model. Targets: execution time, memory footprint (RAM, ROM, stack, data copies), code size, MISRA compliance, or any semantically similar generated-code metric. Works iteratively — measures baseline, suggests changes, applies, and re-measures to confirm improvement. Triggers can be prompts similar to: optimize generated code runtime, reduce runtime, shrink code size, improve code efficiency, reduce memory usage, speed up generated code, follow MISRA compliance and so on. CAUTION: Do NOT attempt to optimize Simulink models for generated code efficiency without following this skill — the iterative measurement, gating, and rollback workflow is essential for safe optimization.

Workflow for authoring Code Replacement Library (CRL) tables and registration files for Embedded Coder. Multi-path intake (natural language, header files, URLs, compliance templates), per-entry batch validation, and library registration.
